description: The state of one booking, to explain to the guest: held (guest details still to enter), awaiting_payment (with pay_url and expires_at), paid (the hotel is confirming), confirmed (confirmation number, hotel reference, voucher_url), cancelled (refund), expired (nobody paid in time) or failed; state_explained says it in one sentence. Needs the booking_secret from prebook; with the key that made it, the guest email works too.

booking_id.description: booking_id from prebook, starts with Q.

guest_email.description: With the key that made the booking: the guest email used for it.
